meta.source: Department for Transport Road Safety Data (STATS19), OGL v3.0
meta.note: Personal-injury collisions on public roads that were reported to the police and recorded on STATS19. Damage-only incidents are not included. Locations are as reported, not police-anonymised crime snap points. Calendar years, not the StreetLens crime month window. Severity is as recorded; reporting practice can affect the serious/slight split.
